issues.description: The problem statement contains conflicting information about the SealSaloon.stock attribute: the UML class diagram presents a stock attribute (no static indication), while the textual instructions explicitly require the stock attribute to be static (shared across instances). The solution implements stock as a static field, but the UML may lead students to expect an instance (final) field. This inconsistency can confuse students about whether the stock should be an instance-level final field or a static shared field.
issues.suggestedFix: Clarify the intended design by making the problem statement and UML consistent. Either update the UML to indicate that stock is a static (class-level) attribute (e.g., underlining or a static marker), or change the textual requirement to require an instance-level final stock. Preferably, explicitly state in the UML or adjacent text that stock is static to match the textual instructions and the reference solution.
